` [Highlight start] There is no guaranteed single cure once a headache starts [Highlight end] ` , so the most reliable approach is **preventing it before you drink** and **managing symptoms** if one hits. Red wine headaches may involve compounds like quercetin (which can interfere with alcohol metabolism), histamines, tannins, or alcohol itself—while sulfites are rarely the culprit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXl7vMEADF-LA6HlYxcB1tvwNuXgO7yLcmOVkCTmEvWgzqNR8gKy08LdMqsRlgvDMSMGhfZGJt09iEXNXevoP3AVcTxWNi3bJycr7AIYktK1TC0XmH_qs5tG7zZW3vJhgxM0jO2Kw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF16_IkFrTZHv92tJGVLG9YVylkaTXzHsjHi69G_2YD4WJLkkojL3HM4J3E87x1qArHFXp6rymH6Uj49yATy9Qiiq3mDD-RtDTExlCZQyz8abbo4CmkIDXE392-3jFqiks0L05-OvyL8yLse3X9D1iQe0Kvj4u3CpVOW9NrGO9ihy_UCuVNeneg1DrK4BaLp224tEd4g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7G4ILZXxDfKhLReW42oc_CfWYVeaOZEFiaBDRhMONoE_3xcXGjFJhTAFdnkTuOCLGCxBQKN-nPg5VvD-JVVA7_7uBPf13N7QwLYSKUGlxa02wjZYr5A7mUu0FUsrbpm4kLFi0zK6)

### Prevention Tips

- **Drink water alongside wine:** Have a glass of water with every glass of wine to stay hydrated and slow your drinking pace.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXDX7k9cR8rOrZ5X-C7lx3CKbF1bY9577D-wQBOcXgQYueu7QuVXaCMW9teUJNcqucBH0sHVa0xh2PmsB3hBxVvW14q1UtBctdszIDziNzdI0KxU1cFqZwEZGm8FKYNfkt2hiLsqHf4yXcYJCyhu7zYfI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXl7vMEADF-LA6HlYxcB1tvwNuXgO7yLcmOVkCTmEvWgzqNR8gKy08LdMqsRlgvDMSMGhfZGJt09iEXNXevoP3AVcTxWNi3bJycr7AIYktK1TC0XmH_qs5tG7zZW3vJhgxM0jO2Kw)
- **Eat before and while drinking:** Avoid drinking on an empty stomach, and limit very sugary foods that can worsen dehydration or headache severity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXl7vMEADF-LA6HlYxcB1tvwNuXgO7yLcmOVkCTmEvWgzqNR8gKy08LdMqsRlgvDMSMGhfZGJt09iEXNXevoP3AVcTxWNi3bJycr7AIYktK1TC0XmH_qs5tG7zZW3vJhgxM0jO2Kw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXDX7k9cR8rOrZ5X-C7lx3CKbF1bY9577D-wQBOcXgQYueu7QuVXaCMW9teUJNcqucBH0sHVa0xh2PmsB3hBxVvW14q1UtBctdszIDziNzdI0KxU1cFqZwEZGm8FKYNfkt2hiLsqHf4yXcYJCyhu7zYfI)
- **Swap your wine style:** Try white or rosé wine, which typically have lower levels of quercetin and grape-skin compounds than red wine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF16_IkFrTZHv92tJGVLG9YVylkaTXzHsjHi69G_2YD4WJLkkojL3HM4J3E87x1qArHFXp6rymH6Uj49yATy9Qiiq3mDD-RtDTExlCZQyz8abbo4CmkIDXE392-3jFqiks0L05-OvyL8yLse3X9D1iQe0Kvj4u3CpVOW9NrGO9ihy_UCuVNeneg1DrK4BaLp224tEd4g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7G4ILZXxDfKhLReW42oc_CfWYVeaOZEFiaBDRhMONoE_3xcXGjFJhTAFdnkTuOCLGCxBQKN-nPg5VvD-JVVA7_7uBPf13N7QwLYSKUGlxa02wjZYr5A7mUu0FUsrbpm4kLFi0zK6)
- **Consider wine filters or targeted remedies:** Some people use purifiers like PureWine The Wand to filter compounds from their glass, while there is a consensus on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF16kt1sZHRdjRult39fctY0MrFP_4l5OcaunnWt9-_lyTzHq9Gv7TsckC_zjEgyR5NWdhIqfV0NhMiM7AdiLbyhasLwPnXoM7ljy_vhFmT0pFShSb6Oij_HMIS-n-zhynQbzUKNmQe4mFyl2BH3txO1yxVNqlWfwsdOouYiQP_YdxXAzxDwbjIPBxgvIRTwbjAUhH8hca) that hydration, antihistamines, or L-cysteine can help prevent wine-triggered migraines. For practical steps on hydration and pairing habits, see [Wine Folly](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHEIkXXzfs72RcA4j9Sz-wEROl2NHniGhXIImQnuVSWBz4SdaHo46ycKcI7kGt13k-gaZeD8DqZf2zlQ_BVvP01qObOhuBUpVHnDrvazPqmKRK37e0fNnUzUK9GzXmRMg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF16kt1sZHRdjRult39fctY0MrFP_4l5OcaunnWt9-_lyTzHq9Gv7TsckC_zjEgyR5NWdhIqfV0NhMiM7AdiLbyhasLwPnXoM7ljy_vhFmT0pFShSb6Oij_HMIS-n-zhynQbzUKNmQe4mFyl2BH3txO1yxVNqlWfwsdOouYiQP_YdxXAzxDwbjIPBxgvIRTwbjAUhH8hca)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw)
- **Use caution with medication:** Taking an over-the-counter pain reliever or anti-inflammatory beforehand is sometimes suggested, though mixing medications like ibuprofen or acetaminophen with alcohol carries risks such as stomach irritation or liver strain—ask a doctor or pharmacist what is safe for you.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7G4ILZXxDfKhLReW42oc_CfWYVeaOZEFiaBDRhMONoE_3xcXGjFJhTAFdnkTuOCLGCxBQKN-nPg5VvD-JVVA7_7uBPf13N7QwLYSKUGlxa02wjZYr5A7mUu0FUsrbpm4kLFi0zK6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXB8cPjfi0rPnsQFkLkpQMF2rSkJZhXcnCVScZmxMEYex6WNT2geeSfF1c_bX9zoHhgfkwLuI7VY9ax5J4NHuBK2VRQMCkfSXPOcnMpZxOq0lKoy_J8WJRiYdGwxbMDYLoMDAhpw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF16_IkFrTZHv92tJGVLG9YVylkaTXzHsjHi69G_2YD4WJLkkojL3HM4J3E87x1qArHFXp6rymH6Uj49yATy9Qiiq3mDD-RtDTExlCZQyz8abbo4CmkIDXE392-3jFqiks0L05-OvyL8yLse3X9D1iQe0Kvj4u3CpVOW9NrGO9ihy_UCuVNeneg1DrK4BaLp224tEd4g)

### If You Already Have a Headache

- **Rehydrate and rest:** Drink water, rest in a quiet or dark room, and try a cool compress on your forehead or temples.
- **Skip more alcohol:** Stop drinking for the night so your body can clear alcohol and its byproducts.
- **Check with a doctor for frequent headaches:** If even small amounts of red wine reliably trigger headaches or migraines, a doctor or headache specialist can help identify triggers and safer options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXzyDLPSZBrTwYQhXMTGkq16eOuuPTcm1R4mS_h5F_J3DxpERhzmJAzt41lTwRn4vcpq34bPqjzQDcudmiQokIhiy-2-Y633ZgUwE9zaZ6bPiPQiJrOPXPXrG4j4CMZd0Ejw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXl7vMEADF-LA6HlYxcB1tvwNuXgO7yLcmOVkCTmEvWgzqNR8gKy08LdMqsRlgvDMSMGhfZGJt09iEXNXevoP3AVcTxWNi3bJycr7AIYktK1TC0XmH_qs5tG7zZW3vJhgxM0jO2Kw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF16_IkFrTZHv92tJGVLG9YVylkaTXzHsjHi69G_2YD4WJLkkojL3HM4J3E87x1qArHFXp6rymH6Uj49yATy9Qiiq3mDD-RtDTExlCZQyz8abbo4CmkIDXE392-3jFqiks0L05-OvyL8yLse3X9D1iQe0Kvj4u3CpVOW9NrGO9ihy_UCuVNeneg1DrK4BaLp224tEd4g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7G4ILZXxDfKhLReW42oc_CfWYVeaOZEFiaBDRhMONoE_3xcXGjFJhTAFdnkTuOCLGCxBQKN-nPg5VvD-JVVA7_7uBPf13N7QwLYSKUGlxa02wjZYr5A7mUu0FUsrbpm4kLFi0zK6)

To help narrow down what might work best for you, share:

- **How quickly** the headache starts (within minutes of a sip or the next morning)
- **Whether you get migraines** or have sensitivities to certain foods or medications
- **Your main goal** (drinking red wine occasionally without a headache or switching to better-tolerated alternatives)

items.text: Drink water alongside wine: Have a glass of water with every glass of wine to stay hydrated and slow your drinking pace. Eat before and while drinking: Avoid drinking on an empty stomach, and limit very sugary foods that can worsen dehydration or headache severity. Swap your wine style: Try white or rosé wine, which typically have lower levels of quercetin and grape-skin compounds than red wine. Consider wine filters or targeted remedies: Some people use purifiers like PureWine The Wand to filter compounds from their glass, while there is a consensus on Reddit that hydration, antihistamines, or L-cysteine can help prevent wine-triggered migraines. For practical steps on hydration and pairing habits, see Wine Folly. - **Check with a doctor for frequent headaches:** If even small amounts of red wine reliably trigger headaches or migraines, a doctor or headache specialist can help identify triggers and safer options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXzyDLPSZBrTwYQhXMTGkq16eOuuPTcm1R4mS_h5F_J3DxpERhzmJAzt41lTwRn4vcpq34bPqjzQDcudmiQokIhiy-2-Y633ZgUwE9zaZ6bPiPQiJrOPXPXrG4j4CMZd0Ejw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXl7vMEADF-LA6HlYxcB1tvwNuXgO7yLcmOVkCTmEvWgzqNR8gKy08LdMqsRlgvDMSMGhfZGJt09iEXNXevoP3AVcTxWNi3bJycr7AIYktK1TC0XmH_qs5tG7zZW3vJhgxM0jO2Kw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF16_IkFrTZHv92tJGVLG9YVylkaTXzHsjHi69G_2YD4WJLkkojL3HM4J3E87x1qArHFXp6rymH6Uj49yATy9Qiiq3mDD-RtDTExlCZQyz8abbo4CmkIDXE392-3jFqiks0L05-OvyL8yLse3X9D1iQe0Kvj4u3CpVOW9NrGO9ihy_UCuVNeneg1DrK4BaLp224tEd4g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7G4ILZXxDfKhLReW42oc_CfWYVeaOZEFiaBDRhMONoE_3xcXGjFJhTAFdnkTuOCLGCxBQKN-nPg5VvD-JVVA7_7uBPf13N7QwLYSKUGlxa02wjZYr5A7mUu0FUsrbpm4kLFi0zK6)
